title: draw-diagram layout document
description: What the planning and layout engine hands the Node converters for one main figure. Phase 1 makes it in Python (py/bridge.py), phase 2 in JavaScript; both must produce the same document. Fields are only ever added, never changed.

kind.description: Which converter draws it: publication-candidates, legacy-technical-annex, semantic-guide, algorithm-dependency-plan, or no layout.

spec.description: The normalized specification: title, summary, category, groups, nodes, edges, each item with origin given|assumed.

structure_layout.description: publication: boxes (normalized), macro_nodes, symbol_metrics (children box_px), typography. legacy: boxes and containers (normalized). behavior: positions and routes in pixels.

layout_scene.description: width, height and routes (points normalized for publication/legacy, pixels for behavior), and quality.

label_layout.description: Edge labels placed on the page (labels) and those left out (deferred_labels).

algorithm_flow_plan.description: algorithm: objects, relations, groups, composition; no coordinates.
